1.web: Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.
1.asv: Hear my cry, O God; Attend unto my prayer.

2.web: From the end of the earth, I will call to you, when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
2.asv: From the end of the earth will I call unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

3.web: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.
3.asv: For thou hast been a refuge for me, A strong tower from the enemy.

4.web: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.
4.asv: I will dwell in thy tabernacle for ever: I will take refuge in the covert of thy wings. [Selah

5.web: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.
5.asv: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: Thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.

6.web: You will prolong the king’s life; his years shall be for generations.
6.asv: Thou wilt prolong the king’s life; His years shall be as many generations.

7.web: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
7.asv: He shall abide before God for ever: Oh prepare lovingkindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

8.web: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.
8.asv: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, That I may daily perform my vows.
